notes: Frame estimates represent action midpoints. The bedroom entry door is opened near frame 1480 for access, but no supported return-to-closed transition is visible before the sequence ends, so it is not counted as a completed on/off episode. The pantry closure is the least certain endpoint because the camera turns away immediately after the closing motion.
